summary: The literal theorem, maximum-size convention, arbitrary-support scope and ordinary-computation assurance are presented consistently with the inspected companion sources. The degree-17 summary table faithfully transcribes its source. Source presentation nevertheless requires revision before rendering: the complete-link formula contains an unprotected Markdown escape, mathematical notation lacks a consistent rendering convention, word-number spacing is repeatedly missing, and bare N is undefined. This round assesses source presentation only and does not certify the finite computations or a rendered artifact.
required_revisions: Adopt a consistent math-aware source convention before rendering. In particular, repair the complete-link definition at manuscript line 35 so that set difference survives Markdown parsing; place formulas in supported math spans/displays or use an unambiguous literal set-difference symbol. Ensure subscripts and cyclic indices retain their intended grouping.

Restore ordinary word-number and bibliographic spacing throughout the manuscript, including Theorem 1, at most 67, degree 17, Proposition 6.7 and 24 October 2026. Preserve legitimate compact mathematical identifiers such as H27 where intended.

Define the bare scalar N used in Sections 5 and 6, or replace its bounds with explicit quantified bounds on |N[R]|. Distinguish this scalar from the set N[R] and the already defined minimum mu so that the graph minimum-degree deduction is readable.

findings.statement: The complete-link expression at manuscript line 35 is ordinary Markdown containing A followed by a backslash and an opening brace. CommonMark treats that backslash as an escape for the brace, so a normal Markdown conversion can erase the set-difference operation. In addition, SF_r and a_(i+3) are literal underscore notation, while the six indented equations are code blocks rather than math displays.
findings.disposition: Repair the source notation and establish the intended math rendering convention; verify the complete-link definition and indexed formulas in the later authorized render. This is a source-level fidelity finding, not a claim that a final PDF has been inspected.

findings.statement: Missing spacing is systematic in prose and references: examples include at most67 and our24October2026 in the abstract, Theorem1 at line 13, Proposition6.7 at line 23, and Computing2(4),479–490,1993 in reference 3. These impede reading and would carry into ordinary rendering.
findings.disposition: Perform a contextual spacing pass without altering compact named mathematical objects or numerical values.

findings.statement: Section 3 defines the set N[R] and its minimum cardinality mu, but Sections 5.1 and 6 use bare N in N<=46, N<=45, N<=44 and N<=43, and also use the compressed label N43 anchor. The scalar's quantifier and relation to N[R] are not stated.
findings.disposition: Add an explicit definition or expand the shorthand at its first use. The final implication from the neighbourhood upper bound to graph minimum degree 25 should refer to the defined quantity.

findings.statement: No authorized final rendering exists for this round, so page breaks, font coverage, equation clipping, table width and Markdown/HTML/PDF visual equivalence remain untested.
findings.disposition: Reserve visual QA for the later authorized final rendering and retain source-only scope for this submission.
